workbench.skills.filterClear.comment: Accessibility label on the button that empties the Skills search field.

workbench.skills.filterPlaceholder.comment: Placeholder in the Skills page search field.

workbench.skills.import.alreadyShared.comment: Import sheet section header for skills that already live in the shared directory.

workbench.skills.import.alreadySharedDet.comment: Caption of the already-shared section. The path and CC Switch are identifiers.
workbench.skills.import.alreadySharedDet.value: These already live in ~/.agents/skills, including layouts created by CC Switch. Vibe Bar records their existing links; it does not import or copy them again.

workbench.skills.import.apply.comment: Confirm button of the import sheet.
workbench.skills.import.apply.value: Apply {count, plural, one {# change} other {# changes}}

workbench.skills.import.conflicts.comment: Import sheet section header for app folders whose name collides with a shared skill.

workbench.skills.import.conflictsCount.comment: Count beside the conflicts section header.

workbench.skills.import.conflictsDetail.comment: Caption of the conflicts section: why nothing was changed and what the user can do.
workbench.skills.import.conflictsDetail.value: A real folder in an app's skills directory has the same name as one in ~/.agents/skills. Vibe Bar will not overwrite it — resolve it by hand, or enable the shared skill for that app once the folder is gone.

workbench.skills.import.foundIn.comment: Caption under an unmanaged directory naming the harnesses whose folders hold it. {apps} is a comma-separated list of harness names.

workbench.skills.import.keepEvidenceFor.comment: Label before the harness circles that choose which existing links the import records.

workbench.skills.import.needsAdoption.comment: Import sheet section header for app-local directories that are not in the shared directory yet.

workbench.skills.import.needsAdoptionDet.comment: Caption of the needs-adoption section: exactly what applying it writes.
workbench.skills.import.needsAdoptionDet.value: These do not exist in the shared directory yet. Selecting one copies it into ~/.agents/skills, then replaces the chosen app copies with managed links.

workbench.skills.import.notSkills.comment: Import sheet section header for directories that hold no SKILL.md.

workbench.skills.import.notSkillsDetail.comment: Caption of the not-skills section. The path and the filename are identifiers.
workbench.skills.import.notSkillsDetail.value: Directories in ~/.agents/skills with no SKILL.md. Left exactly as they are.

workbench.skills.import.recognizedCount.comment: Count beside the already-shared section header.

workbench.skills.import.subtitle.comment: Subtitle of the import sheet: what applying it will and will not touch.
workbench.skills.import.subtitle.value: Vibe Bar already recognizes shared skills. Only selected app-local folders will move.

workbench.skills.import.summary.comment: Import sheet footer totals across the scan's four sections.
workbench.skills.import.summary.value: {adopted} already shared · {unmanaged} need adoption · {conflicts} left unchanged

workbench.skills.importExisting.comment: Skills toolbar and empty-state button that scans the Mac for skills already on disk.

workbench.skills.install.comment: Button on a discover-sheet row that installs that skill.

workbench.skills.installFromZip.comment: Skills toolbar button that opens a file picker for a skill archive.

workbench.skills.menuMoreActions.comment: Accessibility label on a skill row's overflow menu button.

workbench.skills.menuRevealInFinder.comment: Overflow-menu item that selects the skill's directory in Finder.

workbench.skills.menuUninstall.comment: Overflow-menu item that asks to uninstall the skill.

workbench.skills.menuUpdateFromRepositor.comment: Overflow-menu item that re-fetches the skill from its repository.

workbench.skills.menuWiringDetails.comment: Overflow-menu item that opens the per-skill wiring popover.

workbench.skills.noMatch.comment: Card shown when the Skills search field matches nothing. {query} is what the user typed.

workbench.skills.phase.downloadedOne.comment: Progress line when the scan covered exactly one repository.

workbench.skills.phase.downloadedProgres.comment: Progress line while a multi-repository scan runs.

workbench.skills.phase.downloading.comment: Progress line while a repository is being fetched.

workbench.skills.phase.scanning.comment: Progress line while a downloaded repository is being read.

workbench.skills.sourceBranch.comment: Tooltip on the source badge naming the git branch the skill was fetched from.

workbench.skills.sourceInstalledLocally.comment: Tooltip on the source badge when the skill has no repository.

workbench.skills.sourceLocal.comment: Source badge and result-group heading for a skill with no repository behind it.

workbench.skills.state.coupled.comment: Accessibility value of a harness circle: the harness finds the skill without a link of its own.
workbench.skills.state.coupled.value: Available through a shared or compatibility root

workbench.skills.state.disabledInHarness.comment: Accessibility value of a harness circle: linked, but the harness's own switch is off.

workbench.skills.state.enabled.comment: Accessibility value of a harness circle: the skill is linked and switched on.

workbench.skills.state.notProjected.comment: Accessibility value of a harness circle: nothing links the skill into that harness.

workbench.skills.state.unknown.comment: Accessibility value of a harness circle: linked, but the harness config could not be read.

workbench.skills.sync.footer.comment: Footer of the sync explainer popover. {path} is the shared skills directory.
workbench.skills.sync.footer.value: Vibe Bar writes only inside ~/{path}, the per-harness skills folders, and the config files above.

workbench.skills.sync.nativeSwitchesBody.value: Where a harness has its own per-skill off switch, the circles flip that switch. Cursor has none, so every skill in the shared root is always available to it — that is the “shared root” badge, and there is nothing to toggle.

workbench.skills.sync.nativeSwitchesLead.comment: Run-in heading of the sync explainer's third paragraph.

workbench.skills.sync.noPerSkillSwitch.comment: Clause in a harness's one-line sync summary when it has no switch of its own.

workbench.skills.sync.noSwitchAlsoReads.comment: Clause in AntiGravity's one-line sync summary. {path} is the Gemini CLI skills directory.

workbench.skills.sync.perSkillSwitch.comment: Clause in a harness's one-line sync summary naming its config key and file.

workbench.skills.sync.projectionsBody.comment: Sync explainer's second paragraph. The harness names are identifiers and stay as spelled.
workbench.skills.sync.projectionsBody.value: Claude Code and AntiGravity read only their own skills folders, so Vibe Bar links (or copies) skills into them. Codex, Gemini CLI, Grok Build, and Cursor scan the shared root themselves — no link needed.

workbench.skills.sync.projectionsLead.comment: Run-in heading of the sync explainer's second paragraph.

workbench.skills.sync.readsOwnFolder.comment: Clause in a harness's one-line sync summary. {path} is that harness's own skills directory.

workbench.skills.sync.scansSharedRoot.comment: Clause in a harness's one-line sync summary. {path} is the shared skills directory.

workbench.skills.sync.ssotBody.comment: Sync explainer's first paragraph. {path} is the shared skills directory and stays as spelled.
workbench.skills.sync.ssotBody.value: Every skill lives in ~/{path}/<name>. Install, update, and uninstall all happen there and only there.

workbench.skills.sync.ssotLead.comment: Run-in heading of the sync explainer's first paragraph.

workbench.skills.sync.title.comment: Title of the page-level sync explainer popover.

workbench.skills.syncExplainerHelp.comment: Tooltip on the question-mark button that opens the sync explainer popover.
workbench.skills.syncExplainerHelp.value: How skill syncing works — roots, links, and native switches

workbench.skills.toast.addRepoFirst.comment: Toast when a scan is asked for with no repositories configured.

workbench.skills.toast.allUpToDate.comment: Toast after an update check that found nothing to do.
workbench.skills.toast.allUpToDate.value: Every repository skill is up to date.

workbench.skills.toast.archiveEmpty.comment: Toast after a ZIP import that produced no skill.
workbench.skills.toast.archiveEmpty.value: Nothing in that archive could be installed.

workbench.skills.toast.disabledKeptProje.comment: Toast after flipping a harness's own per-skill switch off.
workbench.skills.toast.disabledKeptProje.value: Disabled {skill} in {app} and kept its projection.

workbench.skills.toast.enabledForApps.comment: Second sentence of the archive-install toast. {apps} is a list of harness names.

workbench.skills.toast.importConflicts.comment: Second sentence of the toast after a silent first-run import.
workbench.skills.toast.importConflicts.value: Left {count, plural, one {# conflicting app copy} other {# conflicting app copies}} unchanged.

workbench.skills.toast.importRecognized.comment: First sentence of the toast after a silent first-run import.
workbench.skills.toast.importRecognized.value: Recognized {count, plural, one {# existing skill} other {# existing skills}}.

workbench.skills.toast.installedArchive.comment: First sentence of the toast after installing a ZIP that held one or more skills.
workbench.skills.toast.installedArchive.value: Installed {count, plural, one {# skill} other {# skills}} from the archive.

workbench.skills.toast.installedForApps.comment: Toast after installing one skill into the selected harnesses. {apps} is a list of harness names.

workbench.skills.toast.installedShared.comment: Toast after installing one skill with no harness selected.
workbench.skills.toast.installedShared.value: Installed {skill} in the shared library. Check effective harness state in Skills.

workbench.skills.toast.invalidRepoRef.comment: Toast when the add-repository field holds something unusable or already listed.
workbench.skills.toast.invalidRepoRef.value: “{input}” is not a new owner/repo[@branch] reference.

workbench.skills.toast.linkRemovedStillS.comment: Toast after removing a redundant link from a harness that scans the shared root anyway.
workbench.skills.toast.linkRemovedStillS.value: Removed the {app} link. {skill} stays available there through the shared skills root.

workbench.skills.toast.noSearchMatches.comment: Toast after a community-index search with no hits.

workbench.skills.toast.noSkillsFound.comment: Toast after a scan that read every repository and found nothing.
workbench.skills.toast.noSkillsFound.value: No skills were found in the configured repositories.

workbench.skills.toast.notFoundInRepo.comment: Toast when a skills.sh hit is missing from the repository it named.

workbench.skills.toast.projectionCleared.comment: Toast after removing a projection that turned out to be a real folder Vibe Bar did not create.
workbench.skills.toast.projectionCleared.value: {skill}'s Vibe Bar projection was cleared for {app}, but the existing folder was left in place.

workbench.skills.toast.recorded.comment: Toast after applying the import sheet.
workbench.skills.toast.recorded.value: Recorded {count, plural, one {# skill} other {# skills}}.

workbench.skills.toast.reposUnreadable.comment: Toast after a scan in which more than one repository failed.
workbench.skills.toast.reposUnreadable.value: {count, plural, one {# repository} other {# repositories}} could not be read.

workbench.skills.toast.restored.comment: Toast after restoring a backup into the shared directory.
workbench.skills.toast.restored.value: Restored {skill}. Enable it for the apps you want it in.

workbench.skills.toast.scanStopped.comment: Toast after cancelling a repository scan.

workbench.skills.toast.sharedLibraryNote.comment: Second sentence of the archive-install toast when no harness was selected.
workbench.skills.toast.sharedLibraryNote.value: They stay in the shared library. Check effective harness state in Skills.

workbench.skills.toast.sharedRootNoSwitc.comment: Toast after clicking a circle that cannot change anything.
workbench.skills.toast.sharedRootNoSwitc.value: {app} reads the shared skills root directly — {skill} is always available there and has no per-skill switch.

workbench.skills.toast.uninstalledBacked.comment: Toast after uninstalling a skill that was linked nowhere else.

workbench.skills.toast.uninstalledLeftIn.comment: Toast after an uninstall that left real folders in some harnesses. {apps} is a list of harness names.

workbench.skills.toast.updated.comment: Toast after re-fetching one skill from its repository.

workbench.skills.toast.updatesAvailable.comment: Toast after an update check that found newer commits.
workbench.skills.toast.updatesAvailable.value: {count, plural, one {# skill} other {# skills}} can be updated.

workbench.skills.toggleHelp.installInto.comment: Tooltip on a harness circle in the discover sheet, where the circles pick install targets.

workbench.skills.toggleHelp.keepLinks.comment: Tooltip on a harness circle in the import sheet's already-shared section.
workbench.skills.toggleHelp.keepLinks.value: Keep the {app} links already on disk

workbench.skills.toggleHelp.linkAfterAdo.comment: Tooltip on a harness circle beside an unmanaged directory in the import sheet.

workbench.skills.toggleState.coupledGemi.comment: Tooltip on AntiGravity's circle when the skill reaches it through the Gemini CLI folder.
workbench.skills.toggleState.coupledGemi.value: {app} — visible through the Gemini CLI projection it also reads. Click to give it its own projection.

workbench.skills.toggleState.coupledShar.comment: Tooltip on a harness circle for a harness that scans the shared root and has no switch.
workbench.skills.toggleState.coupledShar.value: {app} reads the shared skills root directly, so this skill is always available there. There is no per-skill switch to flip.

workbench.skills.toggleState.disabledInH.comment: Tooltip on a harness circle whose harness switched the skill off in its own config.
workbench.skills.toggleState.disabledInH.value: {app} — projected, but disabled by its native config. Click to enable.

workbench.skills.toggleState.enabled.comment: Tooltip on a harness circle that is on purely because Vibe Bar linked the skill there.
workbench.skills.toggleState.enabled.value: {app} — enabled by projection. Click to remove it.

workbench.skills.toggleState.enabledNati.comment: Tooltip on a harness circle that is on and whose harness has its own per-skill switch.
workbench.skills.toggleState.enabledNati.value: {app} — projected and enabled. Click to disable in the harness; right-click for projection options.

workbench.skills.toggleState.enabledShar.comment: Tooltip on a harness circle that is on for a harness that would find the skill anyway.
workbench.skills.toggleState.enabledShar.value: {app} — has its own link, and also reads the shared skills root directly. There is no per-skill switch; right-click to manage the redundant link.

workbench.skills.toggleState.notProjecte.comment: Tooltip on an installed skill's harness circle when nothing links the skill there.

workbench.skills.toggleState.unknown.comment: Tooltip on a harness circle whose harness config could not be read.
workbench.skills.toggleState.unknown.value: {app} — projected, but native config could not be parsed. Click to repair as enabled.

workbench.skills.uninstall.comment: Destructive button in the uninstall confirmation dialog.

workbench.skills.uninstallConfirmMessage.comment: Message under the uninstall confirmation title.
workbench.skills.uninstallConfirmMessage.value: The skill is backed up first, and removed from every app that links to it.

workbench.skills.uninstallConfirmTitle.comment: Title of the confirmation dialog for uninstalling a skill.

workbench.skills.wiring.footer.comment: Footer of the per-skill wiring popover: the write scope, in one sentence.
workbench.skills.wiring.footer.value: Vibe Bar writes only inside the skills folders above and the four listed config files, and backs a skill up before uninstalling it.

workbench.skills.wiring.mechanismGeminiC.comment: Wiring popover mechanism line for AntiGravity.
workbench.skills.wiring.mechanismGeminiC.value: Also reads the Gemini CLI skills folder, which holds this skill's Gemini projection.

workbench.skills.wiring.mechanismSharedR.comment: Wiring popover mechanism line for a harness that finds the shared root on its own.
workbench.skills.wiring.mechanismSharedR.value: Scans the shared root itself — no per-app link needed.

workbench.skills.wiring.nativeSwitch.comment: Wiring popover mechanism line naming the harness config entry that switches this skill on or off.

workbench.skills.wiring.noNativeSwitch.comment: Wiring popover mechanism line for a harness with no per-skill switch of its own.
workbench.skills.wiring.noNativeSwitch.value: No per-skill switch — whatever is discovered is active.

workbench.skills.wiring.projectionCopy.comment: Wiring popover mechanism line: Vibe Bar copied the skill into the harness. {path} is a file path.

workbench.skills.wiring.projectionCopyAd.comment: Wiring popover mechanism line for a copy that was already on disk before Vibe Bar recorded it.
workbench.skills.wiring.projectionCopyAd.value: Copy at {path} · adopted from an existing install

workbench.skills.wiring.projectionMissin.comment: Wiring popover mechanism line when nothing links the skill into a harness that needs a link.
workbench.skills.wiring.projectionMissin.value: No entry at {path} — the harness cannot see this skill.

workbench.skills.wiring.projectionSymlin.comment: Wiring popover mechanism line: Vibe Bar linked the skill into the harness. {path} is a file path.
Wiring popover mechanism line for a symlink that was already on disk before Vibe Bar recorded it.
workbench.skills.wiring.projectionSymlin.value: Symlink at {path} · adopted from an existing install

workbench.skills.wiring.reveal.comment: Button in the per-skill wiring popover that opens the skill's directory in Finder.

workbench.skills.wiring.revealHelp.comment: Tooltip on the wiring popover's Reveal button.
workbench.skills.wiring.revealHelp.value: Show the skill's source directory in Finder

workbench.skills.wiring.source.comment: Wiring popover row title for the one real copy of the skill.

workbench.skills.wiring.sourceDetail.comment: Caption under the wiring popover's Source row.
workbench.skills.wiring.sourceDetail.value: One copy of the skill. Every harness below reads this directory or a link to it.

workbench.skills.wiring.stateConfigUnrea.comment: Wiring popover state label: the harness config could not be parsed.

workbench.skills.wiring.stateCoupledGemi.comment: Wiring popover state label: the harness sees the skill through the Gemini CLI folder.

workbench.skills.wiring.stateCoupledShar.comment: Wiring popover state label: the harness scans the shared skills root itself.

workbench.skills.wiring.stateNativeOff.comment: Wiring popover state label: linked, but the harness's own config switches the skill off.

workbench.skills.wiring.stateNotLinked.comment: Wiring popover state label: nothing links the skill into that harness.
